summary_md: **Niko Veit ([@coldniko](https://x.com/coldniko/status/2116442821368713606))** announces **Strata 0.2.9**, adding Unsloth's 1-bit DeepSeek V4.1 Flash quants and speedups on Strix Halo, DGX Spark, Intel Arc B-series and Linux parallel requests; the release card lists DGX Spark decode around 15–26 tok/s for the 1-bit DeepSeek ([release 0.2.9](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/tag/v0.2.9)).
relevance: Local inference engine with explicit DGX Spark gains.

media.description: Strata 0.2.9 release card: 1-bit DeepSeek V4.1 Flash via Unsloth UD-IQ1 quants (241/258 GB), 1.8x faster Qwen prompts on Strix Halo, 1.45x parallel requests on Linux, up to +15.8% on 2x Intel Arc Pro B65, and about 2x on DGX Spark.
media.ocr_text:
Strata 0.2.9 — 1-bit DeepSeek, much faster prompts on Strix Halo, faster parallel requests on Linux.
1-bit DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (new in setup): Unsloth's sets, now a choice on PC, DGX Spark and Mac. UD-IQ1_S 241 GB; UD-IQ1_M 258 GB. UD-IQ1_S decode tok/s: 4x R9700 48-88, DGX Spark 15-26, M5 Max 128 GB 15-18.
Strix Halo · Qwen prompts: 1.8x faster (8K: 791 → 1,424 tok/s, Windows).
Parallel requests (on by default): 1.45x at 8 (Linux NVIDIA, RTX PRO 5000, same answers).
2x Intel Arc Pro B65: up to +15.8% (prompts, 8 at once: 42.1 → 53.8 tok/s).
DGX Spark · DeepSeek 2.25: ~2x faster (short prompts, against 0.2.8).
